verdict.rationale: Superhuman shows some genuine multi-item operations. The MCP integration can 'handle every follow-up with one prompt,' drafting all the nudges and sending them; split inboxes let users work through emails of the same type together; and a user reports being able to trash or mark done all messages from the same sender at once. However, there is no first-party documentation of general bulk select-and-act operations, and the evidence is scattered and thin. Missing for 10: documented general bulk selection/actions (archive, label, move many threads), bulk operations via API or MCP beyond follow-ups, and independent hands-on corroboration of AI-driven bulk actions at scale.
